fun_fact: In August 2026, Earth's atmosphere held more water vapour than in any month on record — about 27.35 kg above every square metre of the planet. The reason: warmer air holds about 7% more moisture for every 1°C of heating, and because water vapour is itself a greenhouse gas, it feeds a loop that drives even fiercer heat and heavier downpours. The muggiest thing in the atmosphere is also one of its biggest climate amplifiers.
author: Sailee
